name: MovieMind
tagline: Recommends films for the reasons you like a movie, by matching your review to others' reviews.

awards: MLH - Best use of MongoDB Atlas

problem: Recommendation algorithms optimise watch time, not why people enjoy films.
solution: Embeds user reviews, finds semantically similar reviews in a vector database, takes the most positive matches as recommendations, and has an LLM explain the reasoning.
demo_moment: Team-described: write why you loved a movie and get explained recommendations.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH - Best use of MongoDB Atlas” among 85 submissions.
Uses the sponsor's vector search as the core of the product.

lessons: Explaining a recommendation is a cheap way to make it feel human.
